## Description

Combines fractional cointegration memory parameters ($d$) with time-varying copulas to model non-linear tail dependency structures across cointegrated assets for robust portfolio optimization.

## Where it may fit

Cointegrated sector baskets, tail-risk equity portfolios, relative value multi-asset allocation.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Funds, Statistical Arbitrage Desks, Risk-Parity Funds.

## Required data

Historical price series of paired assets, fractional differencing parameters, copula fitting windows.

## Caveats

Maximum likelihood copula fitting combined with fractional estimation requires robust historical sample lengths.
